description.value: 2d6 cold damage per rank of this spell, deducted without ceremony. The target then radiates a lingering chill for the duration — any creature that touches it or ends its turn adjacent takes 1d6 cold damage, once per creature.

cinderfall.incomplete: The lingering-chill radius around the target (damages anyone who touches it or ends a turn adjacent) resembles an Aura rule element in shape, but every real Aura usage found is on a creature's own permanent statblock, not on a companion Effect item applied to a spell's target -- no citation for that specific combination was found, so it is not shipped as a ready block. The direct cold damage half needs no rule element (lives in system.damage) and is not a gap. See feats-class-reckoner-draft.md open question 4.
